meta.title: The First & Only Indian Restaurant in Da Nang 🇮🇳 | Beachfront Dining & Indian Food in Vietnam
meta.description:
Hi everyone! 

Looking for Indian food in Vietnam with a view? In this video, we take you to Nazare Indian Cuisine — the first and only Indian restaurant in Da Nang, located right by the beach! 🌴☀️

Nazare is part of the same restaurant group as Maazi Indian Restaurant in Hanoi, which has become a favorite among Indian travelers and expats. If you missed our review of Maazi, check it out here: 👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kjWZJIzI1EE

✨ Why we recommend Nazare:
✔️ Authentic and flavorful Indian food in Vietnam
✔️ Beachfront dining with a relaxing seaside breeze
✔️ Professional Indian chefs & welcoming service
📍 Central location — easy to add to your list of things to do in Da Nang

Whether you're craving butter chicken, paneer tikka, or just a warm naan by the ocean, Nazare is the perfect place to enjoy Indian food in Vietnam in a beautiful, laid-back setting.

This spot isn’t just a meal — it’s an experience. And for travelers wondering about things to do in Da Nang, a visit to Nazare is a flavorful break from the usual.

💬 Have you tried Indian food in Vietnam yet? Let us know in the comments!

🎥 Watch now and don’t forget to like, share & subscribe for more foodie finds and travel tips with GADT Travel.
